title: NC-FILED-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-15-t662: Cache D1 config reads at edge with 60s TTL to cut Worker read volume
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item FILED-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-15-t662 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe FILED-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-15-t662
**Status:** open

Cache D1 config reads at edge with 60s TTL to cut Worker read volume

Backlog done check: D1 daily read count drops >40% vs 7-day baseline with no error-rate increase

Triage: Edge caching with 60s TTL requires modifying Worker code/config, which the in-Worker doer cannot do; measurement also needs D1 metrics access. | first step: Spawn a code-capable subagent to implement the cache layer behind a flag, then run the 24h canary comparing metrics.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
